# What it is
The Class Dashboard shows a teacher how each batch is doing. Teachers only see the batches assigned to them.

# What you see
Each student row shows lessons completed, the latest quiz score and time spent. The live data view shows the graphs students send from their IoT kits, and the alerts panel lists any alerts they have set. Filter by subject to focus on IoT or Robotics Foundation.

# Tips
Sort by lessons completed to spot students who need help. Click a student to open their report.
